house.description: Use of public funds to cover abortions under MinnesotaCare restricted.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Health Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health care; restricting the use of public funds to cover abortions under MinnesotaCare; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256L.03, subdivision 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256L.03, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Covered health services.
(a) "Covered health services" means the health services reimbursed under chapter 256B, with the exception of special education services, home care nursing services, nonemergency medical transportation services, personal care assistance and case management services, community first services and supports under section 256B.85, behavioral health home services under section 256B.0757, housing stabilization services under section 256B.051, and nursing home or intermediate care facilities services.

[+(b) Public funds must not be used for coverage of abortion under MinnesotaCare except when the life of the female would be endangered or substantial and irreversible impairment of a major bodily function would result if the fetus were carried to term, or when the pregnancy is the result of rape or incest. +]

[-(b)-][+ (c)+] Covered health services shall be expanded as provided in this section.
[-(c)-][+ (d)+] For the purposes of covered health services under this section, "child" means an individual younger than 19 years of age.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256L.03, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Covered health services.
(a) "Covered health services" means the health services reimbursed under chapter 256B, with the exception of special education services, home care nursing services, nonemergency medical transportation services, personal care assistance and case management services, community first services and supports under section 256B.85, behavioral health home services under section 256B.0757, housing stabilization services under section 256B.051, and nursing home or intermediate care facilities services.

(b) Public funds must not be used for coverage of abortion under MinnesotaCare except when the life of the female would be endangered or substantial and irreversible impairment of a major bodily function would result if the fetus were carried to term, or when the pregnancy is the result of rape or incest.

(c) Covered health services shall be expanded as provided in this section.
(d) For the purposes of covered health services under this section, "child" means an individual younger than 19 years of age.
